```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5, dpi = 150
)
library(jsonlite)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

# Every number in this report is read from the JSON emitted by the Python
# analysis scripts. Nothing is retyped, so the report cannot drift from the
# computation that produced it.
read_report <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Missing %s. Generate it first:\n  python scripts/run_h1_ariana_incremental_omic_value.py --source <workbook> > %s",
      path, path), call. = FALSE)
  }
  fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = TRUE)
}

h1  <- read_report(params$h1_json)
h1w <- read_report(params$h1_weighted_json)
h5  <- read_report(params$h5_json)

# House palette. Deliberately colour-blind safe and theme-neutral.
PAL <- c(real = "#1b6ca8", caution = "#d08c00", negative = "#9c3d3d",
         neutral = "#5c6b73")
theme_o2pk <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey35", hjust = 0)
    )
}
```

# Provenance and standing

All figures below are **measured results on public individual-level data**. No
simulated value and no unverified hypothesis appears in any panel; where a
quantity could not be estimated the objective is reported as `ABSTAIN` rather
than filled in.

```{r provenance}
data.frame(
  Objective = c("H1", "H5"),
  Cohort = c(h1$cohort, h5$cohort),
  Endpoint = c(h1$target, h5$endpoint_class),
  `Source SHA-256` = c(substr(h1$source_sha256, 1, 16), substr(h5$source_sha256, 1, 16)),
  `Status ceiling` = c("exploratory", "exploratory"),
  check.names = FALSE
) |> kable(caption = "Sources, verified by checksum at run time. Neither workbook is committed to the repository.")
```

> **`r h1$target_is`**
>
> MAP-BE is `r h1$map_be`. The column `r h1$prohibited_predictor_absent`
> shares a denominator with the target and is excluded from every arm.

# H1 — incremental value of omics

## Prespecification

```{r h1-prespec}
data.frame(
  Element = c("Frozen in protocol v1.0.0", "Operationalised at analysis time", "Comparators"),
  Content = c(h1$prespecification$frozen_in_v1_0_0,
              h1$prespecification$operationalised_at_analysis_time,
              h1$prespecification$comparators),
  check.names = FALSE
) |> kable(caption = "What was frozen in advance and what was not. Stated separately on purpose.")
```

Validation: `r h1$validation$outer_folds` outer folds x
`r h1$validation$outer_repeats` repeats, `r h1$validation$inner_folds` inner
folds, identical folds across every arm and model.
`r h1$validation$preprocessing`; `r h1$validation$hyperparameters`.

## Arm performance

```{r h1-arms}
arm_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(h1$results), function(model) {
  arms <- h1$results[[model]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(arms), function(arm) {
    s <- arms[[arm]]
    data.frame(model = model, arm = arm, mae = s$mae,
               trimmed_mae = s$trimmed_mae_10pct, log_mae = s$log_mae,
               rmse = s$rmse, p20 = 100 * s$p20_fraction_within_20pct)
  }))
}))
arm_rows$arm <- factor(arm_rows$arm, levels = names(h1$arms))

arm_rows |>
  mutate(across(c(mae, trimmed_mae, rmse, p20), \(x) round(x, 2)),
         log_mae = round(log_mae, 3)) |>
  arrange(model, arm) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Model", "Arm", "MAE", "Trimmed MAE 10%", "log MAE", "RMSE", "P20 %"),
        caption = "Out-of-fold losses, ng/mL. Identical folds throughout.")
```

```{r h1-arm-figure, fig.cap="Mean absolute error by arm. The step down occurs when the omic variables enter, not when the genotype does."}
ggplot(arm_rows, aes(x = arm, y = mae, group = model, colour = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = unname(PAL[c(1, 2, 4)]), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("M0\nclinical", "M1\n+PGx", "M2\n+omic", "M3\n+PGx+omic")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "MAE (ng/mL)",
       caption = "Lower is better. Note M2 versus M3: adding the genotype on top of the omic does not help.") +
  theme_o2pk()
```

## The primary contrast

```{r h1-primary}
pc <- h1$primary_contrast
pl <- pc$primary_loss
lg <- pc$robustness_co_criteria$log_mae
tr <- pc$robustness_co_criteria$trimmed_mae_10pct

data.frame(
  Criterion = c("MAE (primary)", "log MAE (robustness)", "Trimmed MAE 10% (robustness)"),
  Difference = c(round(pl$mean_difference, 3), round(lg$mean_difference, 4),
                 round(tr$mean_difference, 3)),
  `95% interval` = c(
    sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", pl$descriptive_95_interval[1], pl$descriptive_95_interval[2]),
    sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", lg$descriptive_95_interval[1], lg$descriptive_95_interval[2]),
    "-"),
  `Excludes zero` = c(pl$interval_excludes_zero, lg$interval_excludes_zero, NA),
  check.names = FALSE
) |> kable(caption = sprintf("Primary contrast: %s. Negative favours the omic arm.", pc$definition))
```

**`r pc$definition`** gives ΔMAE
**`r sprintf('%+.2f', pl$mean_difference)` ng/mL**
(`r sprintf('%.1f%%', 100 * pl$relative_change_vs_baseline)` versus baseline),
95 % `r sprintf('[%.2f, %.2f]', pl$descriptive_95_interval[1], pl$descriptive_95_interval[2])`,
on `r pl$n_independent_patients` independent patients.

The frozen exploratory success criterion is
**`r if (isTRUE(pc$exploratory_success_criterion$threshold_met)) "MET" else "NOT met"`**:
`r pc$exploratory_success_criterion$threshold`, observed
`r sprintf('%.1f%%', 100 * pc$exploratory_success_criterion$relative_improvement)`.

Reversal rule: primary improved = `r pc$reversal_rule$primary_improved`,
trimmed reversed = `r pc$reversal_rule$trimmed_mae_reversed`,
log reversed = `r pc$reversal_rule$log_mae_reversed`, so the status is
`r if (isTRUE(pc$reversal_rule$status_capped_at_partially_supported)) "CAPPED at PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED" else "not capped"`.

## Forest plot of incremental gains

```{r h1-forest, fig.height=5.5, fig.cap="Paired ΔMAE for each secondary contrast, by model, bootstrapped over patients. Intervals crossing the dashed line are compatible with no effect."}
forest <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(h1$secondary_contrasts), function(model) {
  contrasts <- h1$secondary_contrasts[[model]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(contrasts), function(label) {
    c0 <- contrasts[[label]]
    data.frame(model = model, contrast = label, estimate = c0$mean_difference,
               low = c0$descriptive_95_interval[1], high = c0$descriptive_95_interval[2],
               excludes = c0$interval_excludes_zero)
  }))
}))
forest$contrast <- gsub("_clinical_pgx_omic|_clinical_omic|_clinical_pgx|_clinical", "", forest$contrast)
forest$contrast <- gsub("_vs_", " vs ", forest$contrast)

ggplot(forest, aes(x = estimate, y = contrast, colour = excludes)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = low, xmax = high), height = 0.18, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(~model, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = PAL[["real"]], `FALSE` = PAL[["neutral"]]),
                      labels = c(`TRUE` = "interval excludes 0", `FALSE` = "compatible with 0"),
                      name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "ΔMAE (ng/mL), negative favours the richer arm", y = NULL,
       caption = "One primary contrast only (Ridge M3 vs M1) is unadjusted; all others are secondary within the H1 family.") +
  theme_o2pk() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## Influence — where the gain comes from

```{r h1-influence}
inf <- pc$influence
data.frame(
  Quantity = c("Patients improved", "Patients worsened", "Net gain (ng/mL, summed)",
               "Share of net gain from the five most-improved"),
  Value = c(inf$n_improved, inf$n_worsened, round(inf$net_gain, 1),
            sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * inf$share_of_net_gain_from_five_most_improved))
) |> kable(caption = "Mandatory influence reporting, protocol section 2.2.")
```

```{r h1-quartiles, fig.height=3.4, fig.cap="Mean gain within endpoint quartiles. The gain is positive in every quartile, so it is not confined to one end of the concentration range."}
q <- inf$mean_gain_by_endpoint_quartile
qdf <- data.frame(quartile = names(q), gain = as.numeric(unlist(q)))
ggplot(qdf, aes(x = quartile, y = gain)) +
  geom_col(fill = PAL[["real"]], width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Endpoint quartile (lowest to highest concentration)", y = "Mean gain (ng/mL)",
       caption = sprintf("Five of 47 patients carry %.0f%% of the net gain; read this panel together with that.",
                         100 * inf$share_of_net_gain_from_five_most_improved)) +
  theme_o2pk()
```

## Prespecified dose-weighted secondary target

```{r h1-weighted}
plw <- h1w$primary_contrast$primary_loss
data.frame(
  Target = c(h1$target, h1w$target),
  `ΔMAE` = round(c(pl$mean_difference, plw$mean_difference), 2),
  `Relative` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * c(pl$relative_change_vs_baseline,
                                         plw$relative_change_vs_baseline)),
  `95% interval` = c(
    sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", pl$descriptive_95_interval[1], pl$descriptive_95_interval[2]),
    sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", plw$descriptive_95_interval[1], plw$descriptive_95_interval[2])),
  check.names = FALSE
) |> kable(caption = "The dose-weighted target was prespecified as a secondary. Post-hoc switching between them is prohibited.")
```

# H5 — marker robustness

## Prespecification, and one declared post-hoc choice

```{r h5-prespec}
p5 <- h5$prespecification
data.frame(
  Element = c("Frozen in v1.0.0", "Operationalised later", "Post-hoc choice declared", "Not selective"),
  Content = c(p5$frozen_in_v1_0_0, p5$not_frozen_operationalised_at_analysis_time,
              p5$post_hoc_choice_declared, p5$not_selective),
  check.names = FALSE
) |> kable()
```

## Association with the activity score, by sampling time

```{r h5-time, fig.height=5, fig.cap="Spearman association between each ln ratio and the CYP2D6 activity score at each sampling time, below-LOQ values excluded. Only the 29 h sample reaches significance after correction."}
assoc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(h5$analyses), function(marker) {
  a <- h5$analyses[[marker]]$scenarios$excluding_below_loq$association_with_activity_score
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(a), function(tp) {
    v <- a[[tp]]
    if (isTRUE(v$insufficient)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(marker = marker, time = as.numeric(sub("h$", "", tp)),
               rho = v$rho, low = v$ci_low, high = v$ci_high, p = v$p)
  }))
}))
alpha <- 0.05 / 18
assoc$significant <- assoc$p < alpha

ggplot(assoc, aes(x = time, y = rho)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey45") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = low, ymax = high), fill = PAL[["neutral"]], alpha = 0.16) +
  geom_line(colour = PAL[["neutral"]], linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = significant), size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~marker, ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 29)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = PAL[["real"]], `FALSE` = PAL[["caution"]]),
                      labels = c(`TRUE` = sprintf("p < %.4f (Bonferroni x18)", alpha),
                                 `FALSE` = "not significant"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Sampling time (hours after the meal)", y = "Spearman rho vs activity score",
       caption = "Shaded band is the 95% interval. Early-window intervals overlap the 29 h estimate, so this design does not separate the windows on association strength.") +
  theme_o2pk() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

Early-window compatibility bounds — the widest upper confidence limit between
0 and 5 h:

```{r h5-bounds}
eb <- h5$early_window_compatibility_bounds
data.frame(
  Marker = names(eb),
  `Compatible up to` = round(as.numeric(sapply(eb, \(x) x$widest_upper_confidence_limit_0_to_5h)), 3),
  check.names = FALSE
) |> kable(caption = "These are the bounds, not the 80%-power correlation. They overlap the 29 h estimates.")
```

## Marker reliability on the exact intersection of subjects

```{r h5-icc}
mi <- h5$marker_difference_on_exact_intersection
rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("raw", "time_effect_removed"), function(key) {
  pt <- mi$point_estimates[[key]]
  bs <- mi[[paste0("bootstrap_", key)]]
  data.frame(
    Specification = if (key == "raw") "raw" else "fixed time effect removed",
    `OH-solanidine ICC` = round(pt[["oh4_solanidine_over_solanidine"]], 3),
    `SSDA ICC` = round(pt[["ssda_over_solanidine"]], 3),
    Difference = round(pt$difference, 3),
    `Bootstrap 95%` = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", bs$percentile_95_interval[1],
                              bs$percentile_95_interval[2]),
    `Excludes zero` = bs$interval_excludes_zero,
    check.names = FALSE)
}))
kable(rows, caption = sprintf(
  "Both markers on the same %d subjects, %d bootstrap resamples over subjects. Difference is SSDA minus OH-solanidine.",
  mi$n_intersection, mi$n_bootstrap))
```

The semi-quantitative, counts-based analyte is the more reliable of the two,
and that survives population matching, removal of the postprandial trend and
explicit uncertainty quantification.

# Conclusions actually licensed

```{r status}
data.frame(
  Objective = c("H1 ARIANA", "H1 replication", "H1 genotype over clinical",
                "H1 genotype on top of omic", "H5 sampling-time effect",
                "H5 marker stability", "H5 quantified vs semi-quantitative",
                "H5 food effect", "H5 poor-metaboliser discrimination",
                "H5 between-day reproducibility"),
  Status = c("SUPPORTED (exploratory)", "ABSTAIN", "NOT_SUPPORTED",
             "NOT_SUPPORTED", "PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED", "PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED",
             "SUPPORTED", "INCONCLUSIVE", "ABSTAIN", "ABSTAIN")
) |> kable(caption = "SUPPORTED means a prespecified criterion was actually met, never a qualitative impression.")
```

**What must not be concluded from H5:**

```{r h5-forbidden}
data.frame(Prohibited = h5$must_not_be_concluded) |> kable()
```
